Blizzard pushed 70425 on the evening of 15 Oct with its development notes. On the trees: Shaman's Elemental tree is rebuilt, with Elemental Mastery back as the 31-point talent, Lava Burst moved to row 5, Elemental Fury now behind Lightning Overload, Call of Thunder gone and Improved Fire Nova renamed Trial by Fire. Mage gets Arcane Wrath in row 4 and Missile Barrage in row 1 at 2 ranks, Fire Power drops to 3 ranks, Critical Mass goes to 5 and Wake of Fire is Improved Fire Blast again. Priest gains Dark Inspiration and loses Improved Fade and Shadow Affinity, and Warlock's Malediction is now Grim Reach. Three racials are replaced (Earth Fury, Ruthless and Savage), Read Ley Line is now Read Leyline, Eureka! is an 8 second buff, Touch of the Grave procs more often on a 25 second cooldown and eight more racials changed. Points a link or saved build had on a talent that moved, shrank or left come back to you, with a card saying why.

Blizzard says Shred hits harder in Forever (Class Highlights Part 3, 1:15), and Cat Form now gets the good of weapon enchants and Weightstones (1:42), so the lower percent is not the whole story.
